symptom: An agent created with a Model and no SelectedModel passed check and exec with only an MDL-AGENT02 warning; Studio Pro then reports AE018 "Model version is required for an agent" and Agent Editor 2.2+ refuses to import every agent at startup.
file: mdl/executor/validate_agent_selected_model.go (static, plain create) and validate_agent_left_unset.go validateAgentDocumentsLeftUnset (project phase, create or modify; now returns errors), wired in validate_program.go / validate.go. Tests: validate_agent_selected_model_test.go, validate_agent_left_unset_test.go TestLeftUnset_WithModelIsAnError
cause: The rule was introduced as a warning because the runtime refusal is downstream (startup import); the Studio Pro-side consistency error AE018 was not known then.
insight: **When Studio Pro itself reports a consistency error for a shape, the check rule for it must be an error, not a warning** — a warning lets exec write a model Studio Pro flags red. The severity splits on whether the agent names a Model (AE018 is about a model version), and the project phase keeps its carry: a create or modify that omits the key keeps a stored selected model and is not flagged. Project-phase errors print under 'Reference error' — that label is shared by every project check. Controls: no Model stays a warning; Agent Editor <2.2 stays silent in the project phase; stubbing the severity back to warning fails both tests.
